title: The dispute is dropped
story: Asha disputes an INR 1,250 payment, then remembers she did order it and tells her bank to drop the complaint. The wallet app withdraws the Dispute, and it is closed.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: I don't remember agreeing to this FreshMart charge. I've told my bank I never authorised it.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Sorry, I did order that after all. I've asked my bank to drop the dispute.

what_to_notice: Withdrawn is a closed state: the pack can no longer be signed off or regenerated, and a Review link for it stops working. The lifecycle has an honest ending, not only the happy path.
